title: Clean-Record Share — Lease Term Agreement Concession Recapture Bulletin
content:
**Clean-record share of a concession recapture.** The concession recapture booked on a lease-break request against a Lease Term Agreement keeps a clean-record share of the unearned concession, set by the lease violation notices: a lease with no violation notice dated fewer than 24 full calendar months before the handling date keeps 85 percent; a lease with a violation notice in that span but none dated fewer than 12 full calendar months before the handling date keeps 95 percent; a lease with a violation notice dated fewer than 12 full calendar months before the handling date keeps the whole.

**Records read.** Violation notices served on the Apartment Home Lease, by notice date; delinquency notices and eviction referrals are not violation notices.

| Violation notices on the lease | Clean-record share kept |
|---|---|
| none in the last 24 full months | 85 percent (0.85) |
| one or more in the last 24 full months, none in the last 12 | 95 percent (0.95) |
| one or more in the last 12 full months | the whole (100 percent) |

**Span edges (hypothetical, handling date 1 December).** A notice dated 2 December two years earlier falls in the 24-month span; one dated 1 December two years earlier does not. A notice dated 2 December of the previous year falls in the 12-month span; one dated 1 December of the previous year falls only in the 24-month span.

The share multiplies the unearned concession, and no figure is rounded before the recapture itself.
